entries.title: Imperator: Rome
entries.definitive_edition: Imperator: Rome on Windows PC with content packs

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.version: Current 2.x PC release with DLC/content packs
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and strongest Imperator: Rome route, with the DLC/content-pack path, mod support, keyboard-and-mouse controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility. macOS and Linux are valid native routes, but Windows PC is the safest complete recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam, GOG, or Paradox and add the content packs you want, especially Heirs of Alexander for the later major content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Punic Wars, Magna Graecia, Epirus, and Heirs of Alexander are content packs/DLC, not separate game entries. Development/support was suspended after launch, so treat the current 2.x branch as the practical final route.
